prompts.S_SW_W:
Create production game sprites of Fabius ROCK / NORMAL performing the FIRST LIGHT KATANA ATTACK (Leve1). Full original character figures, not body-part composites. Rock is exactly the SAME young adult-stylized man as canonical Requiem: identical face/head/age/body height/limb proportions and short layered DARK BROWN canonical haircut, no increase in hair length/volume or infant/chibi redesign. Dark RED eyes where visible, clean warm skin. Rock CLOTHES: black sleeveless studded biker vest, black shirt with small white skull/heart/triangle chest emblem, bare arms, plain black fingerless gloves and short studded wrist cuffs, black pants, silver belt, silver chain at ANATOMICAL LEFT hip, black buckle boots. Only clothes/accessories change from Requiem. No long coat. No crystals, magical transformation armor, aura, colored/glowing hair, red/purple blade or tinted face. Neutral SILVER steel katana, black/gunmetal hilt, anatomical RIGHT hand in EVERY pose. LEFT hand empty as guard/counterbalance. Never mirror or swap chain/hand asymmetry.
FOUR COLUMNS are the same four existing Leve1 phases:0 raised right-arm anticipation;1 horizontal accelerating/contact slash with only a small WHITE/SILVER trail;2 downward/across follow-through;3 balanced recovered sword guard. Reproject the same whole attack into each actual orientation. Stable body/head scale, believable elbow/wrist/hilt connection, grounded support and coherent hips/shoulders. Entire hair/head/both hands/body/feet AND FULL katana tip included in EACH drawing. Very generous transparent separation, no overlap or edge cutoff. Actual transparent RGBA background, same slightly elevated RPG camera and crisp deliberate pixel-cluster raster. No floor, cast shadow, fog/gradient, checkerboard, text/labels/grid/borders, blur/smoothing, anatomical assembly, face transplant, flat rotations or warps.
TWELVE complete figures,4 columns x3 rows. Image1 is approved canonical body and source S/W poses. Image2 supplies approved SW poses specifically in its MIDDLE ROW. Image3 is Rock clothing/style/identity already locked in this session. ROW1 SOUTH/front: four corresponding poses from row1 of image1, face/chest/pelvis/boots front. ROW2 SOUTHWEST front-left45degrees: four poses from MIDDLE ROW of image2; head/nose/chest/hips/toes point down-left together, no repeated frontal view. ROW3 WEST true LEFT PROFILE: four poses from LAST ROW of image1, nose/boots LEFT and ONLY ONE visible eye; empty near LEFT arm and far RIGHT sword arm remain anatomically correct. Do not use Requiem coat in new Rock images. Sword and body remain in same orientation through whole phase; no head/torso mismatch.
